name: ToggleButton
description: A button that stays pressed until pressed again, for turning a mode on or off, like Bold or Mute. Group several with ToggleButtonGroup for single or multiple choice.

size.description: Control height, from the shared control sizes.

variant.description: Default is filled when pressed; outline keeps a visible border.

onChange.description: Called when the pressed state changes.

children.description: Text or an icon. An icon-only button needs an aria-label.

keyboard: Tab moves to the button; in a group, to the group
Space or Enter toggles the focused button
In a group, arrow keys move focus between buttons
requirements: A toggle button exposes aria-pressed (in a single-choice group, the group is a radiogroup and each button a radio)
The pressed state is shown by fill and weight, not only by color
An icon-only button has an accessible name
A group has an accessible name
screenReader: Announced as a toggle button, pressed or not pressed
In a single-choice group, as a radio button, checked or not checked

use_when: A mode that stays on: bold, mute, pin
A toolbar of formatting options, several allowed at once
avoid_when: An on or off setting inside a form: use Switch or Checkbox
Mutually exclusive views of data: use SegmentedControl
anti_patterns: Changing the label when pressed as well as the state, which reads as the opposite
Icon-only buttons with no accessible name
